description: Get a completed upload batch by batchId (or its alias uploadId), or poll a background media-ingest job by jobId until complete is true. Job polls return the full result, progress and file list by default; pass compact:true for counts and failed files only.

accountId.description: Optional ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

compact.description: Opt in to counts and failed files for jobId polls. Default false returns the full result, progress and files.

jobId.description: Background ingest job ID. Poll until complete is true; the final batch summary is returned in result.

uploadId.description: Alias for batchId. ads_upload returns batchId; ads_create calls that same batch ID uploadId. The per-file multipart uploads[].uploadId in a presigned ads_upload response is a storage upload ID used by ads_upload_finalize, NOT a batch ID, and must not be passed here.

name: ads_get_upload
title: Get Upload Status
